usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.chat.completions.messages.list("completion_id", after: "after", limit: 20, order: "asc")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.chat.completions.messages.list(completion_id, after: nil, limit: nil, order: nil) -> Page<Models::ChatCompletionMessageListDataItem>

fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last message from the previous pagination request.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for messages by timestamp. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order. Defaults to `asc`.

fields.name: annotations
fields.description:
Annotations for the message, when applicable, as when using the
[web search tool](/docs/guides/tools-web-search?api-mode=chat).

fields.name: role
fields.description: The role of the author of this message.

fields.name: function_call
fields.description: Deprecated and replaced by `tool_calls`. The name and arguments of a function that should be called, as generated by the model.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier of the chat message.
